pages.title: Getting Blueprints
pages.text: Two ways:$(li)$(l)Scan$() your own builds with the $(item)Structure Scanner$()$(li)$(l)Find$() curated discs in any structure chest, or by brushing archaeology sites$(br2)Operators can also import $(l).schem$(), $(l).litematic$() and $(l).nbt$() files with $(o)/mc3dprint import$().

pages.title: Never the Same Twice
pages.text: With $(o)noDuplicateBlueprints$() on (the default), loot never hands you a build you already have, until you have found them all.$(br2)Whether that set is shared or per-player follows your library, and the default $(item)Blueprint Repository$() is shared.$(br2)Discs drop at a base $(l)40%$().

pages.title: Operator Tools
pages.text: $(o)/mc3dprint discovered list$() shows how many builds are found and how many remain.$(br2)$(o)add <build>$() marks one as already found, for a world that predates the ledger.$(br2)$(o)reseed$() re-syncs from the $(item)Blueprint Repository$().$(br2)$(o)reset$() clears the ledger so everything is findable again.

pages.title: Discs in Creative
pages.text: In $(l)Creative$(), MC3DPrint can list $(l)every$() curated $(item)Blueprint Disc$() it ships, or just a small hand-picked launch set, your call. Toggle it in $(o)mc3dprint-common.toml$():$(br)$(o)[general]$()$(br)$(o)allowAllDiscsInCreative$()$(br2)Cosmetic only: survival still finds every build as $(l)world loot$() either way.

pages.title: Scan Size
pages.text: The $(item)Structure Scanner$() caps each axis at $(l)33$() by default. Capturing something $(l)bigger$()? Set$(br)$(o)[scanner]$()$(br)$(o)unlockScannerSize = true$()$(br)in $(o)mc3dprint-common.toml$() to scan up to the largest printable size (51 with a $(l)Tier 8$() fabricator).

pages.title: Cross-mod builds
pages.text: Some curated builds use $(l)another mod's blocks$() and only appear when it is installed.$(br2)The $(l)Coppertide Park$() set is built from $(item)MC Waterslides$() blocks: install that mod and its six discs join creative and world loot. Costs derive from its recipes automatically.
